description: This file defines the AuthenticationException class within the OrangeHRM system, representing various authentication-related error scenarios as static factory methods. It extends the Exception class, uses a trait for internationalization, and provides normalization of errors for external handling.

classes.name: AuthenticationException
classes.description: Custom exception class for authentication errors with predefined static methods for common error types, using internationalization support.
